import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { Broker, BrokerService } from '../broker.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-broker', templateUrl: './broker.component.html', styleUrls: ['./broker.component.css'] }) export class BrokerComponent implements OnInit { kompanija: string = 'Еурохаус АД Скопје'; broker: Broker | null = null; error: string | null = null; constructor(private brokerService: BrokerService) { } ngOnInit(): void { } getBroker(): void { this.brokerService.getBroker(this.kompanija).subscribe({ next: (broker) => { this.broker = broker; this.error = null; }, error: (err) => { this.broker = null; this.error = err.error?.message || 'Failed to fetch broker'; } }); } }
